step2.ptxt: If a malfunction occurs in the radar cruise control system, the system blinks the "CRUISE" indicator as shown in the illustration and stores the diagnosis results in the engine control computer.

item.ptxt: When the malfunction returns to normal, the light stops blinking.
The data stored in the computer memory will be erased, so do not remove the EFI fuse, ETCS fuse or battery terminal until the inspection is complete.

step2.ptxt: If any of the following conditions occur, the system erases the stored vehicle speed and cancels cruise control. At this time, the "CRUISE" indicator blinks until the main switch is next turned ON, the master warning light comes on with a "beep" warning sound, and "Cruise System Check" is shown on the display. Cruise control is prohibited until the main switch is turned ON again.
